description: This file contains styling definitions for dropdown components, including various dropdown positions, responsive behaviors, and appearance states such as dark mode. It primarily defines CSS variables, mixins, and styles for dropdown wrappers, menus, dividers, items, headers, and variations like dropup, dropdown-end, and dropdown-start.
